title: Miami Wakesurf and Skyline Boat Cruise
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Set sail from the Venetian Marina on a private wakesurf and skyline cruise that showcases Miami's vibrant charm from the water. As you glide through Biscayne Bay, soak in stunning views of iconic landmarks like Brickell and Downtown Miami, while enjoying the thrill of watersports behind a state-of-the-art wake boat. Whether you’re a novice or a pro, our expert instructors will have you wakesurfing in no time. Between rides, enjoy the warm waters, take memorable photos, and keep an eye out for dolphins swimming alongside. This is your chance to relax and embrace the good life in Miami.
